name: Custom Command
description: Run a command on the host as its non-admin account (PowerShell on Windows) and show its output, repeated at the interval you choose.
author: Bosun

permissions.label: See Custom Command widgets
permissions.description: See the Custom Command widget and the output of its command.

permissions.label: Run commands
permissions.description: Choose the command of a Custom Command widget (it runs as the non-admin account of the host).

widgets.description: Run a command on the host as its non-admin account (PowerShell on Windows) and show its output, repeated at the interval you choose

config_schema.label: Command
config_schema.description: Runs as the non-admin shell account of the host (no sudo or Docker access) each time the widget repeats. On Windows the untouched default shows how long the machine has been up. Only people with the permission to run commands can change it.

config_schema.label: Repeat every (seconds)
config_schema.description: How often the command runs, from 10 to 3600 seconds. The result is shared by everyone viewing the widget.

blocks.text: Runs as the non-admin account of the host, every {config.interval} s.
